ctx.x: There were a couple of, there was one little Jewish kid, smart kid, James Cohen. He had, he has a coin, an antique store on Royal Street today. His, his, his uncle was a Feldman who owned about three antique stores on Royal Street. They were well to do and I can remember they had, the family had a Pierce Arrow, big, like a touring car. Yeah. And they'd come pick him up after school with this huge Pierce Arrow. It was impressive. I tell you, I remember till today. It impressed me, I know. But, yeah, so, so I, I…
